$comment: Vendoring contract for packages/engines. Checked by tools/check-vendored-engines.mjs; see that file for the model. Every deviation from canonical is enumerated below with a reason, and every differing or extra path is pinned to the blob currently vendored, so a second drift on an already-known path still fails.

excludedDomains.reason: NextGen teaches no downstream course and ships no downstream panel; the whole domain is deliberately not vendored (audit Group 0).
NextGen teaches no wellsite course and ships no wellsite panel; the whole domain is deliberately not vendored (audit Group 0).

NextGen teaches no stratigraphy course; the domain is deliberately not vendored (audit Group 0). The single exception is engines/stratigraphy/lithology.js, which IS vendored because engines/welldata/lasBlocks.js imports it.

NextGen vendors only the facilities engines its courses need: separatorSizing.js and spacing.js for FC1 Separation, lineHydraulics.js for FC2 Pipeline & Line Sizing, pumps.js and compression.js for FC3 Rotating Equipment, gasProcessing.js for FC4 Gas Processing, relief.js for FC5 Relief & Flare Systems, heatTransfer.js for FC6 Heat Exchange & Cooling, and producedWater.js for FC7 Produced Water Treatment. The remaining four facilities engines have no NextGen course yet. This corrects the audit, which recorded facilities as wholly absent; FC1 (#135), FC2, FC3, FC4, FC5, FC6 and FC7 all landed after it was measured.

knownTestFailures.$comment: Suites that already fail against the vendored engines, from before this guard existed. tools/run-vendored-engine-tests.mjs refuses any NEW failing suite and refuses a suite listed here that now passes, so the list can only shrink.

suites.reason: NextGen vendors newer fdp tests and goldens than the engines/economics/fdp/* code beside them. Cleared by the audit's Group 4 economics re-vendor, which must carry the EC6 recut.
Same cause: newer screening tests than engines/economics/screening.js. Cleared by Group 4, which must carry the EC3 recut.

Before FC3 this path was ledgered as "missing", which was true of the whole facilities domain until a course needed it.

FC6 Heat Exchange & Cooling vendors the heat transfer family from engines main AFTER the FC6-0 repair merged (engines PR #202, merge e4377b3), which is ahead of the canonical pin at 709172f. The vendored blob is sha-identical with engines origin/main at e4377b3, proved path by path over the WALKED IMPORT CLOSURE (five paths, three edges, and heatTransfer.js imports nothing at all) and byte-compared against the Suite's own vendoring of the same repair (Suite PR #499, merge 8a371c94, vendor pin e4377b3e), so this is a pin that has not caught up rather than a local edit. It clears when canonical is next advanced. Before FC6 this path was ledgered as "missing", which was true of the whole facilities domain until a course needed it.

FC7 Produced Water Treatment vendors the produced water family from engines main AFTER the FC7-1 repair merged (engines PR #206, merge 9874d583), which is ahead of the canonical pin at 709172f. FC7-1 followed FC7-0 (#201) and repaired the three defects the FC7 course foundation found in it: a bed area that moved nothing below 1 m/hr, the one device threshold nobody had declared, and a silent way back to the quantised median. The vendored blob is sha-identical with engines origin/main at 9874d583, proved path by path over the WALKED import closure, which was re-walked at the new commit rather than assumed and is still five paths and three edges, and proved three independent ways: git blob hash, md5, and sha256 plus cmp over a fresh git-archive extraction. The Suite comparison used at FC7-0 is NOT available here, because the Suite's packages/engines is still pinned at FC9-0 (engines d4c19ad, an ancestor of 9874d583) and has not vendored FC7-1 yet. So this is a pin that has not caught up rather than a local edit. It clears when canonical is next advanced.

Vendored at engines 3bac13cd, the FC5-0 relief-and-flare repair, which is AHEAD of the pinned canonical 709172f. The repair stopped `blowdown` returning a depressuring time of ZERO with no error key and the vessel still at its start pressure, removed a hidden 0.975 on the caller's discharge coefficient, gave the knockout drum a holdup input that can move its own answer (the two (1-f) factors cancelled exactly), validated every certified coefficient, and replaced five oracle transcriptions with independent derivations. The FC5 Relief and Flare Systems course grades against THIS revision and its digest is built from it, so it moves only with a recut of that course. Pinned to the blob so a second drift still fails.
